properties.notes: This SHELAA site (BAS026) is owned by a Housing Association, who are actively persuing it for residential development. A planning application has been submitted and is at an advanced stage (17/04029/FUL). The council has accepted, through a previous planning application on the site, that the loss of a care facility is acceptable in planning terms. The re-use of the site for residential development is therefore established. The site is deliverable within five years.. Residential development of 12 units. http:www.basingstoke.gov.uk/SHELAA
